implementation_choices: A format enters a category's joint model only if at least 18 of its 24 fit months are usable (the 75% coverage rule of Study 3 addendum c) and it has at least 12 nonzero months itself (the record's feasibility threshold applied per format). The category is feasible when at least one format enters. Formats that do not enter contribute neither Y nor mu to that test.

A window needs at least 2 usable months (the analogue of addendum b); a calendar month never seen in the fit gets no prediction and its Y is left out of the window sums, so Y and mu always cover the same format-months.

The trend t is in years centred on the middle of the fit window; month-of-year dummies for the calendar months present, with the first as reference (the format intercepts absorb it). Same model as the record's formula.

phi has no floor (record formula); the per-format z uses the joint phi; sum Y = 0 gives tau = -inf and z = -inf (kept for ranking), and such tests leave the pooled means and the carry-over regression and are counted.

Value level: shares among the values placed in a node (values without a node are left out, as in the node assignment); a format keeps only values with at least 12 nonzero months in that format over all time (a value below that can never be feasible); zero months inside usable months count as zeros. Counts are stored sparsely.

LibriVox: every month with views is complete (Study 3 choice); its tests are separate, with their own exposure and placebos from LibriVox categories, and are outside BH, pooling and the carry-over regression. Inference

Placebo categories include too-sparse ones; the shift screen counts any shift start (both sources, every class, seasonal and flagged included, as in Study 3). At the value level only 614 Wikipedia and 185 GDELT value series exist, so values without a series are treated as shift-free; `p_cat_p_screened` ranks the same test among placebo values that have a series (robustness, not the record's p).

Placebo years: "no shift in that window" uses months -6..+6 around the placebo month; the placebo fit must be feasible and its full primary window available; the comparison is on the primary window; a year needs its fit window inside the data.
Month 0 is the month of the shift week's Monday (Study 3). Several shifts of one category in one month 0 share one test.

BH family: all non-sparse joint Seattle tests of the main analysis (labelled, quality-ok, not seasonal) at a level, both sources together; seasonal shifts form a separate family; too-sparse tests are reported separately. Pooled means by source x level x duration class, source x level, and level, with and without the too-sparse tests; bootstrap intervals are 95% percentile intervals.

Shifts without a record duration class (interrupted, censored) are not tested; they still count in the screens. Flagged shifts (addenda g and i) are tested only in the `--include-flagged` robustness run.
Per-format effects have no placebo p (the placebo table holds joint fits only). Power

The same draws are used for every lift (common random numbers), drawn uniformly without replacement within a size band (with replacement if a band has fewer units); bands are the quartiles of sum mu over all placebo units of the level (category x month 0 with a feasible fit, no shift in -6..+6, from the study start); detection uses the primary window. A lift of 0 is run as a false-positive check and is not part of the minimum detectable effect. Power is run for the Seattle joint model only. Carry-over and sentiment

The carry-over regression is fitted per source and level on main-analysis shifts; there is no format term; too-sparse tests are left out of the main model and added in a sensitivity model; the Study 3 lag of the peak gap is not repeated.

Each sentiment feature enters its own model (the tone features are collinear); the two-sided placebo p is the share of placebo coefficients with |coef| >= |real coef| (every shift's feature replaced in turn by a placebo window of its category); a shift blocks max(4 weeks, class bound, real-time count, whole duration) of its category for the placebo windows; windows are drawn with the bootstrap seed, without replacement when enough exist; the interaction model holds negative shift, the sustained dummy and their product and the placebo test replaces negative shift (and so the product); models are per level on GDELT main-analysis shifts that are non-sparse with sum Y > 0; partial GDELT weeks are missing. Positive controls

A control is "not testable" only when its model cannot be fitted (not feasible); the pass rule is the record's (tau > 0, one-sided placebo-category p < 0.05, joint Seattle model). Values inside a control node (parent equal to the node) are reported descriptively. Interest side (02)

The value-level shifts use the Study 3 interest code unchanged (armed reading, GDELT thresholds equal to Wikipedia's). Value level = level 4. The existing weekly value files are used after a check that recomputes eight Wikipedia value series from the daily page views.

Quality flags: `one_day` from the weekly `top_day_share` of the value series; `desktop_only` from the driver page's desktop share (the rules of interest/09, not tuned), using cached answers where the same page and window exist and at most one new request per second with the project user agent otherwise; `title_confusion` only where the same page and a start week within 2 weeks carry a verdict in `wiki/review_title_confusion.csv`; GDELT `single_site` only where the driver code and day have a sampled URL list. Computed for labelled shifts from 2017-01 (the tested set). Nothing was checked by hand; what could not be screened is counted in the 02 report.
Implementation: z tables are stored as float32 for placebos while the treated category is refitted in float64; the cache file records the panel build and the settings hash.

reason: Choices the Study 3b record does not make; chosen while coding and testing on simulated panels; only structural panel counts and interest-side value shifts were run on real data. Source: code/main_study/study3b/README.md. The value-level placebo universe keeps the record's reading (all values without a detected shift), with a screened-universe p as a robustness check.
